scope: Existing D06 summaries, source review and synthetic algebra only; no new D arrays, checkpoints or training.
notes: Marginal quantiles cannot identify which paired units improved or attribute SSE gains to a subgroup.
Temporal true_peak in D06 is observed peak, including nonS_alarm; predicted peak is a separate diagnostic.
The displayed path bound assumes each single-mode state and deposit has norm at most one.
Affine feature balancing preserves the compensated forward function, not Adam trajectories or optimizer state.

additional_anchor_amplitude_check.interpretation: Coordinate-box upper bound; shared weather-to-raw map may not attain it. This is structural coupling, not a measured optimization cause.

bounded_output_local_gain_caveat.counterexample: f(v)=(sin(v),cos(v)) is bounded with derivative norm 1, but is not globally injective.
bounded_output_local_gain_caveat.application: 64-to-32 write map cannot preserve all 64 input directions because of rank; boundedness alone is not a general local-Jacobian-degeneracy theorem.
